methodology.riskyPick: One additional player per team chosen outside the top three for a combination of long verified odds, useful model probability and price-vs-model edge.
methodology.note: Probabilities are model estimates, not guarantees. Actual sportsbook prices are displayed only when a verified quote is present.

games.method: Competing Poisson hazards calibrated to sportsbook game total/team strength, blended with de-vigged first-goal consensus when sufficiently covered.
